args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation local function inside(child,parent) if not child or not parent then return false end local cp,cs,pp,ps=child.AbsolutePosition,child.AbsoluteSize,parent.AbsolutePosition,parent.AbsoluteSize return cs.X>0 and cs.Y>0 and cp.X>=pp.X-1 and cp.Y>=pp.Y-1 and cp.X+cs.X<=pp.X+ps.X+1 and cp.Y+cs.Y<=pp.Y+ps.Y+1 end a:Invoke('SetInventorySearch','__inventory_no_match__') task.wait(.1) local empty=a:Invoke('InventorySnapshot') local selectionCleared=#(empty.visibleKeys or {})==0 and empty.selected==nil a:Invoke('SetInventorySearch','') task.wait(.2) local s=a:Invoke('InventorySnapshot') local l=s.layout or {} local window=g:FindFirstChild('InventoryWindow',true) local gridPane=g:FindFirstChild('InventoryGridPane',true) local grid=g:FindFirstChild('InventoryGrid',true) local toolbar=g:FindFirstChild('InventoryToolbar',true) local detail=g:FindFirstChild('InventoryDetail',true) local drawer=g:FindFirstChild('CompactDetailDrawer',true) local gridPositive=gridPane and grid and gridPane.Visible and grid.Visible and gridPane.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and gridPane.AbsoluteSize.Y>0 and grid.AbsoluteSize.X>0 and grid.AbsoluteSize.Y>0 local restoredInside=inside(gridPane,window) and inside(grid,gridPane) and inside(toolbar,gridPane) local drawerClosed=detail and not detail.Visible and drawer and not drawer.Visible return H:JSONEncode({ok=selectionCleared and s.visible==true and l.compact==true and l.detailMode=='Drawer' and drawerClosed and gridPositive and restoredInside,selectionCleared=selectionCleared,compact=l.compact,detailMode=l.detailMode,drawerClosed=drawerClosed,gridPaneVisible=gridPane and gridPane.Visible,gridVisible=grid and grid.Visible,gridPaneHeight=gridPane and gridPane.AbsoluteSize.Y,gridHeight=grid and grid.AbsoluteSize.Y,gridPositive=gridPositive,restoredInside=restoredInside})
